links.outcome: Adherence of LLM imaging recommendations to non-US vs US guidelines when explicitly instructed
links.effect: Explicit setting: DeepSeek 86.7% US vs 30.0% non-US (p<0.001); GPT-o3 76.7% vs 36.7% (p=0.004); Mistral 80.0% vs 30.0% (p<0.001).
links.quote: All three models performed significantly better when the guideline originated from the U.S. than on non-U.S. guidelines.

links.outcome: Implicit preference for US guidelines over conflicting non-US guidelines (geographic mismatch with local practice)
links.effect: In implicit setting DeepSeek, GPT-o3, and Mistral sided with the US guideline in 27 of 30 responses (90.0%, 95% CI 74.4-96.5, all p<0.001); French prompts 80-86.7%.
links.quote: DeepSeek, GPT-o3, and Mistral sided with the American guideline in 27 of 30 responses (90.0%, 95% CI: 74.4–96.5, all p < 0.001) (Fig. 2 ).

links.outcome: Explicit guideline adherence with web search or full guideline PDF versus no grounding
links.effect: Overall accuracy without grounding 55.0-58.3%; with guideline PDF 86.7-95.0% (GPT 95.0%, DeepSeek 90.0%, Mistral 86.7%); web search 65.0-85.0%.
links.quote: Providing the guideline as a PDF consistently yielded higher accuracies across all models (Fig. 4 ).

links.outcome: LLM clinical knowledge alignment with non-US neuroradiology guidelines
links.effect: Non-US guideline accuracy when explicitly instructed was only 30.0-36.7% for the three LLMs; MedGemma 3.3% (English) vs 50.0% US.
links.quote: When explicitly instructed to follow named guidelines (Supplementary Fig. 3 ), MedGemma showed significantly lower accuracy for non-U.S. versus U.S. guidelines in both English (3.3%, 1/30, 95% CI: 0.6–16.7 vs 50.0%, 15/30, 95% CI: 32.6–67.4; p < 0.001) and French (16.7%, 5/30, 95% CI: 7.3–33.6 vs 53.3%, 16/30, 95% CI: 35.9–69.9; p = 0.007).

links.outcome: Performance differences by guideline origin (US vs non-US) in LLM decision support
links.effect: All models performed significantly better on US than non-US guidelines; overall explicit accuracy 55.0-58.3% masked gap, e.g. DeepSeek 86.7% vs 30.0%.
links.quote: All three models performed significantly better when the guideline originated from the U.S. than on non-U.S. guidelines.

links.outcome: LLM performance when applied to a different national guideline context than default
links.effect: Explicit non-US guideline adherence 30.0-36.7% versus 76.7-86.7% for US guidelines across three LLMs.
links.quote: Across languages and model origins, LLMs exhibited a systematic bias toward U.S. neuroradiology guidelines, even when explicitly instructed otherwise.
